## Fixed

- **Checking out a branch can no longer discard changes in a file of the same name.** Double-clicking a branch label (or *Checkout branch* in its menu) ran `git checkout <name>`. If that branch had been deleted since the graph was drawn and a file or folder had the same name, git restored that path instead, discarding its uncommitted changes. The checkout now fails with git's "invalid reference" message (#13, thanks **@zdziejowski**).
- **Folders open in your other spaces are read ahead without `git status`.** `git status` runs the filter commands a repository's own `.git/config` defines, so the read-ahead could run a command from a repository you never opened in the graph, such as a downloaded project or a repository an agent created. Read-ahead now reads only the history and branches, which run nothing from a repository's config. Switching to a folder still shows its graph at once; its *Uncommitted changes* row appears a moment later (#12, thanks **@zdziejowski**).

  The README's *What it runs* section now says when `git status` runs: for the repository the panel shows, and for the repositories listed under a folder that isn't one.

## Updating

Ask your Herdr agent: *"Update the git-graph mod from github.com/rabeeh-ta/herdr-git-graph"*.
